ownership.quote: Claw2Agent gives OpenClaw its own cloud computer, connects Telegram, and keeps it ready while your laptop sleeps.

stage.note: No press coverage, Crunchbase/LinkedIn presence, founder names, or accelerator affiliation could be found (web search returned zero results for the name and site). The product itself is in a pre-launch/closed state: pricing plans are flagged 'closed' and terms of service are 'not yet approved as binding' per the card's own caveats. Likely a very early, possibly solo-founder or side project; no evidence of any priced funding round, so stage cannot be determined beyond 'unknown'.

note: Claw2Agent is a small, apparently pre-launch/closed-beta hosted wrapper around the open-source OpenClaw agent (created by Peter Steinberger), running each customer instance on a Hetzner Cloud VPS. No founder names, company registration, accelerator batch, funding round, or revenue figures could be located via web search (DuckDuckGo returned zero results for the name/domain) or on the company's own site, which has no About/team/press page. Its own pricing/security pages state public signup, payments, and production-data intake are closed pending legal review, and access is by selective application (Cloud Pilot) — consistent with a very early-stage, likely bootstrapped or unfunded project rather than an institutionally financed company, but this is inference, not confirmed evidence.
